proof_body:
by
  intro ι s x y z mx my mz Vx Vy Vz C hs hz hmx hmy hmz hVx hVy hVz hC
  have hmz' : mz = mx + my := by
    rw [hmz, Finset.sum_congr rfl hz, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_div, ← hmx, ← hmy]
  have h : ∑ i ∈ s, (z i - mz) ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) ^ 2 + 2 * ∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) * (y i - my) + ∑ i ∈ s, (y i - my) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hz i hi, hmz']
    ring
  rw [hVz, h, hVx, hVy, hC]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (x y z : ι → ℝ) (mx my mz Vx Vy Vz C : ℝ), s.Nonempty → (∀ i ∈ s, z i = x i + y i) → mx = (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / s.card → my = (∑ i ∈ s, y i) / s.card → mz = (∑ i ∈ s, z i) / s.card → Vx = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) ^ 2) / s.card → Vy = (∑ i ∈ s, (y i - my) ^ 2) / s.card → Vz = (∑ i ∈ s, (z i - mz) ^ 2) / s.card → C = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - mx) * (y i - my)) / s.card → Vz = Vx + 2 * C + Vy
